title: L2–L4 腰椎の論文由来参照寸法と監査条件（第一著者表記修正）

primarySource.title: The morphology of the lumbar vertebrae: a systematic review with meta-analysis of 1481 individuals with implications for spine surgery
primarySource.verifiedInSource: Bonczar et al. Table 3–5; Surgical and Radiologic Anatomy 47, article 22 (2025); first online 2024-12-06

interpretation.samplingMethod: Upper endplate width anchors scale independently for each level; other body and pedicle parameters derive as dimensionless ratios to width.
interpretation.limits: Pedicle X/Z rays are not minimal perpendicular isthmus sections. Facet curvature/orientation and adjacent-joint congruence are not yet validated. ±5% is an internal research screening threshold, not a medical certification threshold.

referenceGeometryCandidate.name: BodyParts3D official archive 4.0
referenceGeometryCandidate.intendedUse: independent reference-only shape comparison; not embedded in this model
referenceGeometryCandidate.caveat: Older versions and third-party distributions may have different license terms; verify the exact asset/version before use.

calibration.anchor: Set project-units-per-mm using L3 superior endplate width / (2 * project L3 W=8.10)
calibration.sourceToModelConversion: Upper endplate widths, depths, and anterior body heights map to design half-extents; pedicle widths/heights and spinal canal widths map to preliminary section parameters only.
calibration.caution: Published group means are NOT normative patient-specific standards; v2.3 uses fixed local mesh-ray scans for pedicles, separate proxy section screening for canal and mesh topology checks. Neither is CT surface registration.

corrections: Correct first-author designation: Bonczar et al. (Koziej is coauthor, not first author).
Do not treat acceptable proxy dimensional error as clinical anatomical approval.
Add sided pedicle width and height means and gate descriptions.

qualityScreening.note: Project-internal screening only; not a medical or clinical tolerance.
